"''Yes, Master. Fang Zar need no longer concern you.|Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader|}} '''Fang Zar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the early [[Standard year/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was an outspoken opponent of the centralization of power experienced by the Galactic Republic during [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] chancellery and became involved with a group of [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalists]] known as the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]]. Zar was a key member in the group's plan to "restore honor to the Republic" by revealing the [[Insignia of Unity]]; however, intervention by the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] left the plan in obscurity for decades. His opposition to Palpatine eventually led him to become a member of the [[Delegation of 2000]], a group of senators and [[Junior Representative/Legends|representatives]] who disapproved of the sweeping amendments made to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] over the course of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Zar accompanied other members of the delegation to present the [[Petition of 2000]] to Palpatine in the hope that the Supreme Chancellor would begin to relinquish some of the powers granted to him by the constitutional amendments. The delegation's plea fell on deaf ears, and Palpatine seized absolute power, transforming the Republic into the Galactic Empire at the close of the Clone Wars. The new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] targeted members of the Delegation of 2000 as traitors to the Empire, and Zar was [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|detained]] for a time by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Upon release, he was ordered to remain on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; however, the [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]] native abandoned his post as Senator and fled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. There, Zar was granted [[Politics/Legends|political]] asylum by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], a founding member of the Delegation of 2000. After residing in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] for several weeks in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Zar's flight from Coruscant was revealed to the Emperor, who dispatched [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to retrieve the former Senator and return him to the Imperial Security Bureau. Not wanting to involve Organa in his troubles with the Bureau, Zar contacted a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] to obtain passage from Alderaan to Sern Prime. The crew of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' undertook the mission to transport Zar and was successful in recovering the former Senator from the Royal Palace. However, before he boarded the ''Drunk Dancer'' and departed Alderaan, Zar was attacked by Darth Vader, who [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the Senator. The blade cut through Zar's chest, resulting in his [[Death/Legends|death]] shortly thereafter on the ''Drunk Dancer''{{'s}} operating table. ==Biography== ===The Clone Wars and a dying Republic=== {{Quote|Yes, we cannot block the Chancellor's supermajority—but we can show him that opposition to his methods is growing. Perhaps that alone might persuade him to moderate his tactics.|Fang Zar|}} [[File:Bail_Organa_and_Mon_Mothma.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Senators Bail Organa and Mon Mothma, two of Zar's closest allies]] The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Fang Zar hailed from [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. Zar owned estates on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], as well as [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], all three of which he frequented. He was eventually elected to represent the Sern [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. In his time in office, he gained a reputation as a staunch defender of civil liberties and a strong critic of the sweeping amendments made to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] during the reign of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Chancellor's aides quickly identified Zar as an obstacle to be removed; however, Zar's colleagues in the Senate held him in high regard. At some point during his career, the Senator became a member of the clandestine [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]], which sought to limit Palpatine's growing control over the Republic. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Zar became a close ally of several like-minded Senators, including [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Zar was also as a good friend of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], who was absent from the Senate during the early stages of the Clone Wars as a result of his enactment of ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', which closed the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] off from the Republic.{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}} Shortly after the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] government decided to once again retreat from the Republic's forefront and defend its own borders, a decision Zar supported due to his friendship with Iblis.{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}} By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Senator of the Sern sector had been appointed to the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], an advisory council of Senators formed by Chancellor Palpatine several years prior. At that time during the conflict, the Committee consisted primarily of Senators who opposed the Chancellor's methods of waging the war as well as the Senate's continuing compliance with his wishes. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Zar and several of these Senators organized a meeting with the Supreme Chancellor in order to bring their concerns before him. [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], a close [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Chancellor, attempted to delay and derail their meeting; however, the Senators proved persistent and refused to leave Palpatine's office until they were granted an audience with the Chancellor. Meeting with Palpatine, Zar and his allies pressed Palpatine to rescind several measures outlined in the [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]] that had been passed by the Senate earlier in the war. They claimed that the removal of [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate forces]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories negated the necessity of such decrees. The discussion moved to the Senators' desire to see a peaceful end to the war, and at this point, Zar suggested that the Republic cede embattled [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds to the Confederacy, as Core and Inner Rim trade had been restabilized since the start of the war. Intent on continuing the war until the Confederacy issued an unconditional surrender, Palpatine dismissed both the Senators' and Zar's proposal. ====Plans with the Republic Group==== {{Quote|Think of the ship as a key—the key to a treasure. A treasure sufficient enough to restore Republic honor to the galaxy.|Fang Zar, to Tobb Jadak, regarding the ''Stellar Envoy''|}} [[File:StellarEnvoy-SWE.png|thumb|right|230px|The ''Stellar Envoy'', a key part of the Republic Group's plan to weaken Palpatine's influence]] Later that year, Zar and his confidants in the Republic Group, including Senators [[Largetto]] and [[Des'sein]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]], decided that the Republic was headed down a dark path caused by Palpatine's growing and unchecked power. Over a [[29 BBY/Legends|decade earlier]], the Republic Group had stolen the [[Republic crest/Legends|Insignia of Unity]], the symbol of the Republic, from the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] while it underwent heavy renovations. The group planned to re-reveal the Insignia of Unity to the Senate, hoping it would serve as a reminder to those who had fallen under the Chancellor's sway that their duty was to the Constitution and the people of the Republic, not its leader. While Zar and the other members of the group awaited the arrival of information on the Insignia's whereabouts, the Confederate [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|surprise invasion]] of Coruscant. During the fighting, Grievous himself abducted Palpatine from Coruscant and attempted to flee the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] with his hostage. A successful rescue attempt was mounted by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], during which the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. By the time Palpatine was returned to the Senate, the Republic Group's couriers, [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Reeze Duurmun]], were able to make it to Coruscant's surface and rendezvous with Zar, Largetto, Des'sein, and Shé at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Jadak and Duurmun arrived in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']], a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by the Group, and delivered a case containing recorded information on the Insignia. While Master Shé installed a transponder on the ''Stellar Envoy'' that would allow the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to access the Insignia, which was hidden away on [[Tandun III]], Zar explained to Jadak and Duurmun that their next mission was to deliver the ''Envoy'' to an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] known as [[Aren Folee|Folee]] on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. Folee was then to retrieve the Insignia of Unity and return it to the Republic Group on Coruscant. However, Zar and the Republic Group's plan never came to fruition. [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], the [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] and an ally of Palpatine's, was informed by a member of his staff of the group's meeting and dispatched a contingent of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] to interrupt the proceedings. Zar and the other Senators were taken to safety by Master Shé before the trooper's arrival, but Jadak and Duurmun were chased off planet by clone forces. The two made a desperate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they collided with a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] and were believed to have been killed. In reality, only Duurmun was killed, while Jadak entered into a decades-long coma. The ''Stellar Envoy'', which was believed to have been destroyed, was instead reclaimed and repaired by mechanic [[Bammy Decree/Legends|Bammy Decree]] who then gave it to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] criminal [[Rej Taunt]]. The Republic Group's plan to reveal the Insignia of Unity to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] thus went unheard of for over half a century. ====The Petition of 2000==== {{Quote|You must trust me to do the right thing. That is, after all, why I am here.''"
"''But surely—''"
"''I have said I will do what is ''right''. And that should be enough for your…committee.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and Fang Zar discuss the Delegation of 2000's position|}} [[File:Npep3delsceneconfrontchancello3.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Zar and other Senators present the Petition of 2000 to Palpatine]] In the immediate wake of the invasion of Coruscant, the governmental infrastructure of the Republic underwent radical changes. The day after the invasion, the Senate held a vote on an [[Security Act amendment|amendment]] to the Security Act, which passed by a wide margin. The amendment transferred command of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] from the Senate to the office of the Supreme Chancellor and removed congressional oversight of the Republic's military. The following day, Palpatine issued the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], a proclamation that installed [[Moff/Legends|Regional Governors]] to oversee sectors within the Republic. To Zar and his allies, these developments meant the end of the Senate and the Republic's democracy. Hoping to create a cohesive opposition to Palpatine, Senators Organa and Mothma organized a meeting between themselves and other Senators that they believed they could trust. Zar was invited to the meeting in Organa's offices alongside Senator [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], Senator [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]] of [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]], and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Organa and Mothma expressed their concerns about the path the Supreme Chancellor was leading the Republic down and began to hint at actions they were prepared to take.{{DB|character|amidala|Amidala, Padmé}}{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}{{DB|character|monmothma|Mothma, Mon}} Zar and Amidala were wary of these "actions," but nevertheless agreed to keep the meeting confidential. Following the discussion, Organa and Mothma drafted a [[Petition of 2000|petition]] that called for Palpatine to begin relinquishing his emergency powers, as the end of the war appeared to be drawing near with the death of Count Dooku. Zar signed the petition alongside 2,000 other Senators and Senatorial delegates. The signatories, who became known as the [[Delegation of 2000]], met in [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Padmé Amidala's apartment]] to discuss bringing the Petition before Palpatine. During the meeting, Zar expressed his belief that the existence of the petition alone might pressure Palpatine to moderate his policies, and that involving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the Delegation's struggle was premature, contrary to Senator Amidala's claims. The Delegation resolved to present the petition to the Supreme Chancellor and voice their concerns on the Sector Governance Decree. Zar accompanied Amidala, [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]], [[Nee Alavar/Legends|Nee Alavar]], and [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] to a meeting with Palpatine in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Executive Office]], where the Chancellor was once again dismissive of their concerns. However, Palpatine was now flanked by Anakin Skywalker, whose presence overshadowed the original intent of the conference. Skywalker noted to himself that Zar seemed to be hiding something and that he was the only Senator present who was capable of becoming a threat to Palpatine's regime. Zar attempted to push Palpatine on the pursuit of a diplomatic solution to the war, but was quickly cut off by the Chancellor and excused from his offices. ===Imperial justice=== {{Quote|We are cheered by this victory, but deeply disappointed that public servants could fail the Emperor so completely. Be confident that we will not relent until the prisoners have given up the names of their accomplices.|Armand Isard, to HoloNet News, on the arrest of members of the Delegation of 2000|}} [[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Alderaan, Zar's final refuge]] Only days after Zar's meeting with the Supreme Chancellor, Palpatine called an [[Special session of Congress/Legends|Extraordinary Session]] of the Senate that every delegate was obligated to attend. During the session, Palpatine declared the Clone Wars over and issued the [[Declaration of a New Order]], proclaiming himself the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and transforming the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Palpatine framed the Jedi for planning a rebellion to overthrow the Senate and accused members of the Delegation of 2000 of plotting alongside the Order. Shortly after the birth of the Empire, Zar was one of sixty-three Senators from the Delegation that were [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by the newly formed [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agency.{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}} He was held in custody on Coruscant, where he was interrogated by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] on the members and activities of the Delegation. Zar, now no longer a sitting Senator, was eventually released from custody but ordered by the ISB to remain on Coruscant. He instead fled the Imperial capital and sought refuge on Alderaan. Bail Organa, unaware that Zar had illegally left Coruscant, allowed the former Senator to stay in [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Palace]] for several weeks. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a conflict on Sern Prime that was preventing Zar from returning to his homeworld ended, prompting him to contact the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Cash Garrulan]] on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]]. Zar intended to return to Sern Prime, but he wished to keep Senator Organa oblivious of his fugitive status so as not to implicate his friend in any criminal activities. To that end, Garrulan contacted the crew of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' to discreetly smuggle Zar off Alderaan. While the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] planned to spirit Zar away, Palpatine was informed of the former Senator's flight from Coruscant by [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]]. The Emperor ordered Sate Pestage and his new second-in-command—[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, formerly Anakin Skywalker—to travel to Organa's palace on Alderaan and retrieve the fugitive Zar. Zar planned to have the ''Drunk Dancer'' arrive in [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] on the day that large anti-Imperial protests were occurring outside the palace. While members of the smuggling ship's crew searched the palace for their charge, Darth Vader arrived and was greeted by Bail Organa. Organa and Vader, both unaware of Zar's plan to escape Alderaan, waited while the former Senator was summoned. This allowed Zar time to reach the palace's south gate, where he was originally to be picked up by the ''Drunk Dancer''. However, as the protests outside the south gate became increasingly violent, he was forced to divert to the east gate. The change in plan cost the Senator time and confused the ''Drunk Dancer''{{'s}} crew, [[Skeck Draggle]], [[Archyr Beil]], and [[Roan Shryne]]. After the three encountered [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]], the palace's alarm was activated, alerting Vader to the presence of the smugglers and Zar's attempt at escape. As Zar raced from the south gate toward the ''Drunk Dancer'' parked on a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] correspondent's platform, Vader located him and the three smugglers attempting to catch up with him. Zar and the smugglers reached the loading ramp of the ''Drunk Dancer'', where they were greeted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jula Shryne]]. Vader knew he would be unable to reach the vessel before Zar and the crew boarded and [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] toward them with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The blade cut through Zar's upper chest and came close to decapitating him before swinging around once again to burn Jula Shryne across the back. Roan Shryne aided the mortally wounded Zar onto the ''Drunk Dancer'', which quickly fled to Alderaan. ''En route'' to Sern Prime, a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B medical droid]] began surgery in an attempt to save the former Senator's life. The damage to major blood vessels inflicted by Vader's lightsaber was too extensive to repair, and Zar died on the operating table. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Palpatine wanted to make an example of Fang Zar. He won't hesitate to make an example of Sern Prime itself, if the president-elect isn't careful.|Bail Organa, to Mon Mothma|}} Zar's death had several severe repercussions for those who opposed Palpatine's rule. The crew of the ''Drunk Dancer'' fled to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where they hoped to find Jedi survivors of Palpatine's [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Having confronted Roan Shryne on Alderaan during the fight over Zar, Vader followed the ''Drunk Dancer'' to Kashyyyk and [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|laid siege]] to the planet, burning the forests and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] much of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population. On Sern Prime, the president-elect threatened to recall the planet's delegation from the Senate in anger over the death of its Senator. Vader was troubled by the events on Alderaan, and his handling of the situation led him into an argument with his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], Palpatine. The Emperor, however, was pleased with the outcome. The Senate believed that Zar had committed sedition on Coruscant and had fled to Alderaan to inspire rebellion against the Empire. His death served as a reminder to other Senators that dissent would not be tolerated in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and that the power lay with the Emperor. Bail Organa remained silent about the events that transpired within his palace, hoping his complicity would lure Palpatine into trusting him. Mon Mothma disagreed with Organa's actions, however, believing that Zar's death could be a lightning rod to gather those who would openly challenge Palpatine. Zar's death instead resulted in over half of the Delegation of 2000 rescinding the demands made in the petition. Fang Zar was replaced in the Imperial Senate by [[Gebnerret Vibrion]], a Ghorman native.{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm}} In [[43 ABY]], Zar and the Republic Group's plans to discredit Palpatine were rediscovered by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] during their investigations into the history of their ship, the ''Stellar Envoy'', now known as the ''Millennium Falcon''. The Solos eventually united with Tobb Jadak to seek out the Insignia of Unity and together the four were led by the ''Millennium Falcon'' to Tandun III. There, they discovered that the Insignia that Zar had believed to be authentic was in fact counterfeit. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You underestimate Palpatine's acuity. Besides, he appreciates frank speech.''"
"''We've been nothing if not frank, Senator. With scant success.|Padmé Amidala and Fang Zar|}} [[File:FangZar.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Senator Fang Zar]] Fang Zar was a firm believer in a decentralized government and strong civil liberties. He commanded great respect among his colleagues as a result of his unwavering idealism and straightforward discourse. However, Palpatine's aides and allies kept close watch on the aged Senator. While in office, Zar became close to several other delegates who shared his political philosophy. His views were so similar to those of Garm Bel Iblis that the two Senators could have been one and the same. Fang Zar's outspoken and defiant nature led him to join the Republic Group and the Delegation of 2000, both of which aimed to limit the growing power that Palpatine was gathering in the Republic's [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive branch]]. In the last days of the Clone Wars, Zar focused on bringing the conflict to a peaceful resolution, pushing for the Republic to open negotiations with Count Dooku's Confederacy. Zar was willing to recognize the Confederacy as a legitimate government and even surrender several Outer Rim worlds to the Separatists. Although tireless in his efforts against the Chancellor, the Sern Prime native was cautious when he was approached by Bail Organa and Mon Mothma on taking "actions" against Palpatine. Once he became involved in those "actions," Zar agreed with Senator [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]] that involving the Jedi in their fight against Palpatine was a premature measure. After being arrested following the birth of the Empire, Zar refused to bow to the demands of the Imperial Security Bureau. The now-former Senator fled to Alderaan, but was unwilling to involve Bail Organa in his legal troubles. In an effort to maintain Organa's innocence, Zar kept both his fugitive status and his plans to escape Alderaan from the Senator. Following his death, Zar, who was once considered to be a noble and incorruptible representative of the opposition, was lambasted in the Imperial Senate as a traitor. Zar's demeanor and personal appearance gave him a gruff exterior. The Senator wore his frizzy hair in a traditional Sern Prime topknot, clothed himself in simple robes, and allowed his full beard to grow almost completely white. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We had some great fun doing some different types of makeup with the Senators. Fang Zar, played by Warren Owens, had this fabulous big beard and hairdo that we just tied up into a top knot. Again, I think because the costumes are so elaborate it's very important not to try and compete with them but to just let it flow.|[[Nikki Gooley]]|{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20041026/index.html|text=Nikki Gooley: Making Memorable Faces}}}} [[File:FangZar_CVD.jpg|thumb|Fang Zar in full robe]] Fang Zar was first mentioned in ''[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02]]'', featured in [[Star Wars Insider 75|''Star Wars Insider'' 75]]. Zar's first appearance was in the novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', released in early [[2005]] as a prequel to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Zar was intended to appear in ''Revenge of the Sith'' as one of the Senators who laid the groundwork for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but the scenes he appeared in were cut from the final film. [[George Lucas]] has stated that the scenes were cut due to time constraints and because the subplot involving Padmé Amidala and the formation of the Rebel Alliance was distracting.{{Film|III}} {{C|[[Content cut from Star Wars#Revenge of the Sith|Deleted scenes]]}} Although excluded from the final cut of the movie, the scenes were [[canon]]ized in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] and the ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''. Zar has since appeared in several sources, including the ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization's sequel, ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', and the [[Legacy era]] novel [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Fang Zar was played by [[Warren Owens]] in the deleted ''Revenge of the Sith'' scenes. Casting Director Christine King was inspired to hire Owens for the part after seeing concept art for Fang Zar that included strong aboriginal facial features that Owens possessed. Fang Zar was originally planned to appear in "[[An Old Friend]]," an episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]]. Artist [[Randy Bantog]] had developed designs for Zar's character model by [[April]] [[2011]]; however, Zar was cut before the episode moved past the design stage.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/an-old-friend-concept-art-gallery|text="An Old Friend" Concept Art Gallery}} Despite his exclusion from this episode, Zar does appear in the very next episode, "[[The Rise of Clovis]]." ==Appearances== *{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}} {{1stm}} *{{TCW|An Old Friend}} {{C|Cut}} *{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}} *{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}
